name: Sunray Roslyn 4-Person Infrared Indoor Sauna 400KS
description: Description Bring home the perfect blend of style, comfort, and wellness with the SunRay Roslyn 4-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna. Designed with spacious side-by-side seating, this sauna allows you to relax, unwind, and enjoy the rejuvenating benefits of infrared heat with family or friends. Featuring 10 advanced carbon-nano heaters, the Roslyn quickly reaches temperatures up to 140°F for a deeply soothing experience. Crafted from rich Canadian red cedar wood, it adds elegance and durability to any indoor space. With ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, Bluetooth audio, and purified air through an oxygen ionization system, the Roslyn provides everything you need for an exceptional home spa retreat. Features Comfortably fits up to 4 people with spacious side-by-side seating Constructed from all-natural Canadian red cedar for durability and beauty 10 carbon-nano infrared heaters provide fast, even heating Reaches relaxing temperatures up to 140°F for maximum wellness benefits Low-EMF infrared heating Dual LED control panels for easy temperature and lighting adjustments Ergonomic backrests for long-lasting comfort Chromatherapy mood lighting enhances relaxation and ambiance Oxygen ionization system purifies air for a fresher environment Bluetooth speaker system with cup holders for added convenience Recessed interior and exterior lighting plus an LED reading lamp Tempered glass door for safety and modern style Ventilation system ensures proper airflow and comfort ETL/CSA Safety Certified for reliability and peace of mind Easy to assemble with adult assembly required What's Included?
